scenarios.title: A｜不会使用空调
scenarios.setting: 在“房间温度与空调问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“不会使用空调”。

turns.text: Front desk. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「房间温度与空调问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m having trouble with the air conditioner in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m having trouble with the air conditioner in my room.
feedback.explanation: “air conditioner”指空调设备，通常作为可数名词。

choices.text: Hi, I’m not sure how to use the air conditioner.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m not sure how to use the air conditioner.
feedback.explanation: “air conditioner”指空调设备，通常作为可数名词。

choices.text: Could you tell me how to adjust the temperature?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me how to adjust the temperature?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I don’t know how the air conditioner works.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know how the air conditioner works.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

choices.text: I don’t know how to open the air conditioner.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m having trouble with the air conditioner in my room.
feedback.explanation: 启动空调用“turn on”，不是“open”；“open”容易被理解为打开设备外壳。

turns.text: Of course. There’s a control panel on the wall next to the bed. Can you see it?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己不清楚空调该怎样操作，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, but I’m not sure which button to press.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but I’m not sure which button to press.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: Yes. How do I turn the air conditioning on?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. How do I turn the air conditioning on?
feedback.explanation: “air conditioning”指空调系统或制冷功能；描述故障时可接具体表现。

choices.text: I see it. How do I lower the temperature?

feedback.naturalExpression: I see it. How do I lower the temperature?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Yes, but I don’t know which one I should press.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but I don’t know which one I should press.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

turns.text: Press the power button first, then use the arrows to set the temperature.

turns.prompt: 你想请对方给些推荐，会怎么问？

choices.text: Got it. What temperature would you recommend?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. What temperature would you recommend?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Okay, I think I’ve got it now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I think I’ve got it now.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Great. Let me try that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let me try that.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

turns.text: If you still have trouble with it, just give us a call.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will do. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Will do. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: “will do”简短表示会照办，适合接到明确任务后回应。

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜空调坏了
scenarios.setting: 在“房间温度与空调问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“空调坏了”。

turns.prompt: 你想描述遇到的故障并寻求处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I think the air conditioner in my room isn’t working.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think the air conditioner in my room isn’t working.
feedback.explanation: “air conditioner”指空调设备，通常作为可数名词。

choices.text: The air conditioning doesn’t seem to be working.

feedback.naturalExpression: The air conditioning doesn’t seem to be working.
feedback.explanation: “doesn't seem to be working”说明设备看起来无法正常运作，保留了进一步检查的余地。

choices.text: I’ve turned it on, but nothing is happening.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve turned it on, but nothing is happening.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: I think there’s something wrong with the air conditioner.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think there’s something wrong with the air conditioner.
feedback.explanation: “air conditioner”指空调设备，通常作为可数名词。

choices.text: My air conditioner is broken and can’t use.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think the air conditioner in my room isn’t working.
feedback.explanation: 设备可以说“isn’t working”；如果说不能使用，需用“can’t be used”，而不是让设备自己“use”。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. Is it turning on at all?

turns.prompt: 你想描述遇到的故障并寻求处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, it won’t turn on.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, it won’t turn on.
feedback.explanation: “turn on”表示开启设备电源；它与打开门或盒子的“open”不同。

choices.text: It turns on, but no cold air is coming out.

feedback.naturalExpression: It turns on, but no cold air is coming out.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: The display is on, but the room isn’t getting any cooler.

feedback.naturalExpression: The display is on, but the room isn’t getting any cooler.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: It opens, but doesn’t have cold wind.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, it won’t turn on.
feedback.explanation: 设备开机用“turn on”，空调吹的是“air”而不是“wind”；也要区分完全无法开机和能开机但不制冷。

turns.text: I see. We can send someone up to take a look at it.

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店尽快安排人员检查空调，会怎么说？

choices.text: How soon can someone come?

feedback.naturalExpression: How soon can someone come?
feedback.explanation: “How soon”问多快能办到，强调从现在起还要等多久。

choices.text: Could someone come and check it now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could someone come and check it now?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: About how long will it take?

feedback.naturalExpression: About how long will it take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: When someone can come?

feedback.naturalExpression: How soon can someone come?
feedback.explanation: 问维修人员何时能来应说“When can someone come?”，把“can”放到主语前。

turns.text: Maintenance should be there within fifteen minutes.

turns.prompt: 关于「房间温度与空调问题」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll be in the room. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll be in the room. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: That’s fine. I’ll wait here.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’ll wait here.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great, thank you for arranging that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for arranging that.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: C｜房间太冷 / 太热
scenarios.setting: 在“房间温度与空调问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“房间太冷 / 太热”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明房间温度让你不舒服，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, my room is really cold.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, my room is really cold.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明房间太冷，先让前台了解具体问题，再商量调温或检修。

choices.text: It’s quite hot in my room. Could you help me with the temperature?

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s quite hot in my room. Could you help me with the temperature?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’ve tried adjusting the thermostat, but the room is still too warm.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve tried adjusting the thermostat, but the room is still too warm.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: The room doesn’t seem to be getting any cooler.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room doesn’t seem to be getting any cooler.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: My room has too hot.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, my room is really cold.
feedback.explanation: 描述房间温度用“is too hot / cold”，不用“has”；还要如实区分太热还是太冷，避免要求相反的处理。

turns.text: Have you tried adjusting the thermostat?

turns.prompt: 关于「房间温度与空调问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, but it doesn’t seem to make any difference.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but it doesn’t seem to make any difference.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: Yes. I set it to 20 degrees, but the room is still very warm.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I set it to 20 degrees, but the room is still very warm.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I have, but the temperature hasn’t changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have, but the temperature hasn’t changed.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: Yes, but it’s still same hot.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but it doesn’t seem to make any difference.
feedback.explanation: 温度仍没变可说“still just as hot”；“same”通常修饰名词，不直接和“hot”这样组合。

turns.text: I’ll have someone check the system for you.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. If it can’t be fixed, would it be possible to change rooms?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. If it can’t be fixed, would it be possible to change rooms?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Great. Could you let me know if there’s a problem with the system?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you let me know if there’s a problem with the system?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Thanks. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。
